system.description:
You leap over your opponent while hooking your blade being an enemy’s limbs and pulling violently to sever them. Make a melee taijutsu attack, dealing your weapons damage + 4d8 and the target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save the target loses mobility and function in one of their arms being unable to hold things, form hand seals or manipulate objects with it until the end of their next turn.

Chain 2: On a critical hit, the affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they lose mobility and function in their arms until they have it healed. A jutsu that removes conditions, cast at C-Rank or Higher can heal the targets arm(s), granting it mobility and function.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
